summary: Reuse prepared SQL for the two per-append writer frontier reads.

replay.detail: No replay, rebuild or startup work is added.

schema.detail: No table, column, index, metadata, migration or schema version changes.

rules.detail: Canonical ordering, checkpoints, retention and admission rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The same frontier queries execute for every call with the current origin binding. Only their prepared statement handles use the writer connection existing bounded cache.

manual.detail: No activation flag or operator action is needed.

recovery.detail: No transaction, savepoint, rollback or writer return policy changes.
